team.description: Proof unit for the estate team OS: take the knowledge tree canon live on main (graph, MCP, exports, web, honest waitlist) within 30 days, or dissolve. Serves contributors, learners, agents consuming the graph, and Frank as steward.

stop_conditions: Conflicting ownership, missing authority, or a human gate is reached.
Frank review queue median age over 7 days: stop staging new work.
expected_outputs: Bounded lane contract per work item
Weekly proof numbers (merged nodes, queue age, gate pass rate)

stop_conditions: A change needs a schema migration or touches private data.
expected_outputs: Atomic PRs (one node or one fix per PR)
Validate and export receipts with command output

stop_conditions: A surface would claim counts or seats not read from real storage.
Verifier authored or co-authored the target change: stop and hand to another harness.
expected_outputs: Exact-head verdict with reviewed file list

stop_conditions: Any private title, absolute local path, or personal identifier appears in public data.
expected_outputs: Privacy scan verdict per data PR

handoff_rules: Select only the smallest 3-5 role team needed for the bounded job.
The worker that changes a release surface cannot be its independent verifier. Verifier harness must differ from maker harness.
Stop and request named approval when any human-gated action is required.
Humans only promote a node to stable. Agents propose seed or draft.
One writer per worktree. Branch agent/harness/scope. WIP cap 3 open PRs for this team.

proactive_triggers: validate-graph or community-ci failure on an open PR
new contribution issue from existing templates
review queue item older than 7 days
open team PR older than 7 days without a verifier verdict
canon count drift detected by verify-canon-counts

proof_mission.definition_of_live: Reviewed canon on main proven from a clean clone: validate green, counts equal manifest, exports deterministic, MCP benchmark query returns all benchmark records, web routes render canon-derived counts, waitlist persists real rows or stays visibly closed.
proof_mission.kill_criteria: Not live on main within 30 days: team dissolves. No extension on reports, heartbeats, or proof logs.

evolution.renewal_rule: Profile expires after 45 days. Renewal needs at least one merged non-routine PR in the last 30 days and a re-signed named steward.
evolution.improvement_claim_floor: No improvement claim below an L2 judge eval with absolute numbers (team-evolution-ledger ladder).
